title: ORBIT: Autoregressive Time Series Generation via Next Frequency-Band Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.27000v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep generative models provide an effective modern solution to alleviating the problem of data scarcity by synthesizing realistic time series. However, despite the considerable progress achieved by existing deep time series generators, two key challenges remain: (1) learning hierarchical representations for heterogeneous temporal patterns; and (2) coordinating the generation process of heterogeneous temporal dynamics. To address these key bottlenecks, in this work, we propose ORBIT, a unified deep generative framework for time series. Specifically, we develop two key components: the Frequency-Hierarchical VQ-VAE (FH-VQ-VAE) and the Frequency-Band Autoregressive Transformer (FBAR). The former learns hierarchical representations by decomposing latent temporal representations into different frequency bands and applying residual quantization with increasing token budgets. translated_title: ORBIT：通过下一频带预测实现自回归时间序列生成
translated_abstract: 深度生成模型通过合成逼真的时间序列，为缓解数据稀缺问题提供了有效的现代解决方案。然而，尽管现有的深度时间序列生成器已经取得了长足进步，但仍存在两个关键挑战：（1）为异构时间模式学习分层表示；（2）协调异构时间动态的生成过程。为解决这些关键瓶颈，本工作提出了ORBIT——一个统一的时间序列深度生成框架。具体而言，我们开发了两个关键组件：频率分层VQ-VAE（FH-VQ-VAE）和频带自回归Transformer（FBAR）。前者通过将潜在时间表示分解为不同的频带，并应用具有递增token预算的残差量化来学习分层表示；后者建立了一种新颖的从低频到高频的自回归生成机制（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了统一的时间序列生成框架ORBIT，通过频率分层VQ-VAE学习跨频带的分层时间表示，并利用频带自回归Transformer实现从低频到高频的自回归生成，从而解决了异构时间模式的表示学习与生成协调两大难题。
